description: Figure 12 is a line plot showing Pass@8 accuracy on the merged AIME 2024 and AMC datasets as a function of generation temperature, which varies from 0.1 to 1.0. The x-axis, labeled “Temperature,” is linearly scaled from 0.1 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled “Pass@8 Accuracy,” is linearly scaled from 0 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 20. The plot contains three lines: a red line with circular markers representing SFT, a blue line with square markers representing On-Policy RL, and a green line with triangular markers representing LUFFY. All three lines show an increasing trend in Pass@8 accuracy as temperature increases. At a temperature of 0.1, the SFT line starts at approximately 60, the On-Policy RL line starts at approximately 80, and the LUFFY line starts at approximately 85. As temperature increases, all three lines rise, with the LUFFY line reaching a peak near 95 at temperature 1.0, the On-Policy RL line reaching approximately 90, and the SFT line reaching approximately 85. The SFT line shows a more pronounced decrease in accuracy at higher temperatures compared to the other two methods.
